exposure.needed: which dashboards, alerts or recording rules query the metric doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count

consequence.statement: Cilium now exposes this metric under the name doublewrite_identity_crd_only_total; the old name doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count is no longer used, so any monitoring referencing the old name must be updated to the new name.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and recording rules to reference doublewrite_identity_crd_only_total instead of doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count.

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count has been renamed to doublewrite_identity_crd_only_total.
